name: cloudsent
description: CloudSent — a digital prayer wall for faith, hope, and community

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @cloudsent/api" "npm run dev --workspace @cloudsent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cloudsent/contracts && npm run build --workspace @cloudsent/api && npm run build --workspace @cloudsent/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @cloudsent/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @cloudsent/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @cloudsent/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @cloudsent/api && npm run lint --workspace @cloudsent/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @cloudsent/contracts && npm run test --workspace @cloudsent/api && npm run test --workspace @cloudsent/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @cloudsent/contracts && npm run db:migrate --workspace @cloudsent/api
scripts.admin:bootstrap: npm run build --workspace @cloudsent/contracts && npm run admin:bootstrap --workspace @cloudsent/api
scripts.db:seed:demo: npm run build --workspace @cloudsent/contracts && npm run db:seed:demo --workspace @cloudsent/api
